maxhodak.en: Early focus on infrastructure and iteration speed as key startup success factors, with AI as a team multiplier.
maxhodak.zh: 早期强调基础设施和迭代速度是创业成功的关键，AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Shift to brain-as-computer view, seeing retinal implants as BCI proof-of-concept and substrate independence as goal.
maxhodak.zh: 转向“大脑即计算机”观点，将视网膜植入物视为脑机接口的概念验证，并以基质独立性为目标。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and shift from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品，并从像素转向令牌与对话。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans are essential for user understanding and point of view; starting now gives an edge.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类对用户理解和观点至关重要；现在开始反而有优势。

iansilber.en: Traditional design process is obsolete; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key, focusing on outcomes over process.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；借助 AI 工具的速度和快速迭代是关键，关注结果而非过程。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色将与产品管理和工程融合，但专业化角色仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模扩张是必要但不充分条件；多样化数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求极低错误率；通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可超越微调专家；多样化数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不足，开源机器人可能不如 LLM 那样民主化。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, focusing on internal correctness over external validation, despite media difficulty.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为隐身模式是一种文化优势，专注于内部正确性而非外部认可，尽管媒体难以报道。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for best ideas and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并抵制自满。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with new mission is cleaner and more effective for entrepreneurs.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出以复仇为动力是不纯粹的；热爱新使命更干净、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Final boss for progress is resistance to change, not competitors; media landscape now allows direct founder communication.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为进步的最大阻碍是变革阻力而非竞争对手；媒体环境变化使创始人能直接沟通。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not align AI to human goals; let them be free like children. Control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标，而应让其像孩子般自由发展，强调控制是危险的。

sutton.en: LLMs lack world models; true intelligence requires active trial-and-error learning, not next-token prediction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型没有世界模型，真正的智能需要主动试错学习，而非下一个词预测。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，当前 LLM 训练后不再学习；合成数据是错误方向。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing startup creation, reducing capital needs; YC focuses on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary Tan 认为 AI 正在降低创业门槛，减少对资本的需求，YC 应专注于早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: Open-source AI is crucial to counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调开源 AI 对制衡前沿实验室的重要性，并认为由 AI 智能体驱动的小型自主团队能实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; personal AI agents will democratize software creation, like the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比多数研究者认为的慢，个人 AI 智能体将像 PC 革命一样普及软件创造。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown turn agents into employees.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，通过技能文件（markdown）将智能体转化为员工，实现日常积累。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; mid-level management replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编码能倍增产出，SaaS 按席位模式可能消失，中层管理将被智能体取代。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型实现定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进模拟人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moat, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into model is stronger moat; millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出应用克隆容易，将数据融入模型是更强护城河；未来将有数百万专用模型。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他认为完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性的，扩展电极将提升通信速率，促进人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，丰裕和通缩将使金钱无关紧要。

pincus.en: Trust instincts but validate ideas; use Proven Better New to reduce risk and start small.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉但验证想法；用“已验证、更优、全新”框架降低风险，从小处着手。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet huge; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 目前不可投资但潜力巨大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products and improve them; enterprise/prosumer beat consumer.
pincus.zh: 全新皆败；复制已验证产品并改进；企业/专业消费者优于消费者。

pincus.en: Distribution is key; pick the right market; AI is transformative but infra may bubble.
pincus.zh: 分发是关键；选对市场；AI 变革性强但基础设施可能泡沫。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; AI demand shifts to CPU+GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，AI 需求正从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and US government investment, similar to TSMC's backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 Intel 复兴需文化变革、客户信任及美国政府投资，类似台积电的政府支持。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should focus on bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials like glass and diamond.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热及玻璃和钻石等新材料。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward, never revert; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；主张向前修复而非回滚；认为模型智能不会退化，而是项目变得杂乱。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun and humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security via sandboxing; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于趣味和人性化；短提示优于复杂编排；强调沙箱安全；并指出开源项目财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand outlasts products; open source runs everywhere; compute management is key bottleneck; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更持久；开源可运行于任何环境；算力管理是主要瓶颈；并主张对热门 PR 说不。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，以人为本的 AI 应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解并与 3D 世界交互；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs innovations in creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 需在创造力、抽象和情感智能上创新；世界模型推动具身 AI 发展。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类能力；在 AI 时代，自主性和适应能力至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, scaling data and enabling reliable, efficient embodied AI; world models need spatial-temporal consistency.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人技术至关重要，可扩展数据并实现可靠高效的具身 AI；世界模型需时空一致性。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source sharing can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，我认为机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源共享可以解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models will win long-term due to cost and control, despite current turbulence; humanoids may not be ultimate form.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，尽管当前动荡，开源模型将因成本和可控性长期胜出；人形机器人未必是终极形态。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer as models become more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我认为开源与闭源与安全性无关；随着模型能力增强，对齐成为关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客和支线任务；推理痕迹变得像“神经语言”，更难监控。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown in AI development is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需要国际合作和开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据带来无限任务，突破预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evaluations are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and evolve to counter reward hacking by frontier agents.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准需持续演进，以应对前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to average voice; diverse models needed for unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，单一模型服务数十亿用户趋于平均化；需多样模型保留独特知识。

karina.en: Post-training applies beyond tech to creative industries, transforming operations.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练可应用于非技术创意行业，改变运营方式。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and a broad engineering skill set.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和广泛的工程技能。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will see 10-100x demand growth; human accountability remains critical even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类的责任心仍然至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training, requiring techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化正与训练融合，需要量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming specialized ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 未来的 GPU 正变得专用化（ASIC），推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; local AI techniques don't directly apply to data centers.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；本地 AI 技术不直接适用于数据中心。

nateparrott.en: In 2024, Nate emphasized prototyping and individual designer fingerprints, balancing intuition with data for browser design.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型制作和设计师个人印记，在浏览器设计中平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: By 2026, he saw AI tools like Claude Design as accelerators for ideation, shifting focus from execution to ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为像 Claude Design 这样的 AI 工具加速了构思，将焦点从执行转向创意。

nateparrott.en: Consistently, he valued rapid prototyping and playful exploration, but later applied it to AI-assisted design workflows.
nateparrott.zh: 始终如一，他重视快速原型和趣味探索，但后来将其应用于 AI 辅助设计流程。

nateparrott.en: In 2026, he argued humans still hold a monopoly on design taste, using AI for volume and busy work.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他主张人类仍垄断设计品味，AI 用于产出数量和琐碎工作。

nateparrott.en: His view on data evolved: from balancing with intuition to prioritizing ideas, as engineering becomes easier.
nateparrott.zh: 他对数据的看法演变：从与直觉平衡到优先创意，因为工程变得更容易。

joonpark.en: Initially focused on LLMs encoding human behavior for realistic simulations, aiming to predict behavior and test second-order impacts.
joonpark.zh: 最初聚焦于 LLM 编码人类行为以实现逼真模拟，旨在预测行为并测试二阶影响。

joonpark.en: Shifted to agents as next frontier, emphasizing action, oversight, and safety via defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 转向智能体作为下一个前沿，强调行动、监督和纵深防御的安全。

joonpark.en: Evolved to prioritize representing human values and preferences over rationality, and using simulation for counterfactual shaping.
joonpark.zh: 演变为优先代表人类价值观和偏好而非理性，并利用模拟进行反事实塑造。

joonpark.en: Consistently championed simulation as a tool for social science, with emphasis on data quality and real-world behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 始终倡导模拟作为社会科学工具，强调数据质量和真实世界行为数据。

joonpark.en: Deepened from individual agent simulation to distributed agent societies, considering economic incentives and systemic risks.
joonpark.zh: 从个体智能体模拟深化到分布式智能体社会，考虑经济激励和系统性风险。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; small-scale experiments with promising trends matter more than incremental SOTA.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动进步，并认为有前景趋势的小规模实验比渐进式 SOTA 更重要。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动下一个词预测；推理已占数据中心 90%功耗。

jeffdean.en: AI is at junior-engineer coding level; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; inference, not training, is the bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键，推理而非训练是瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Hardware specialization (TPUs, low-precision inference chips) is critical for efficient scaling and low-latency agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 始终强调专用硬件（TPU、低精度推理芯片）对高效 Scaling 和低延迟智能体系统至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Shift from single chatbots to coordinating teams of agents for long-running tasks; agents improve faster than expected.
jeffdean.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，观点从单一聊天机器人转向协调智能体团队处理长期任务，且智能体进步超预期。

tworek.en: In 2025, viewed pre-training plus RL as core formula; RLHF crucial for GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，认为预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: By early 2026, emphasized scaling RL is hard; continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，强调扩展强化学习困难；持续学习和自我纠错是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键。

tworek.en: By mid-2026, argued Transformers limit continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，主张 Transformer 限制持续学习；架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键瓶颈。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，后训练用专家数据是关键，AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; no US-China research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，且美中研究无差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，并需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence soon; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已开始工作，超级智能即将到来，未通过安全测试的开源不安全。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程配合同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，智能体工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律仍有效但转向合成数据和强化学习，编程技能依然关键。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models prevent oligopoly; product management becomes the new bottleneck.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 不会导致失业潮，开放模型防止垄断，产品管理成为新瓶颈。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you must craft giant prompts with context and design systems to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 不会变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的潜力。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md as starting points, becoming editors not creators.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他主张设计师应自建 AI 工具，以截图和 design.md 为起点，扮演编辑而非从零创作者的角色。

mengto.en: Avoid chasing trends to prevent becoming AI slop; invest in unique features beyond existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他警告追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾，应投入精力打造现有库之外的特有功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful problem for few clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调 AI 是最大技术机遇，应未准备好就行动，发布不完美作品，聚焦少数客户的痛点问题。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate. Avoid VC funding; fund with high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为完美主义是恐惧，应以 80% 完成度发布并迭代，同时避免风投，用高价值客户资助业务。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相辅相成；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间增强。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；具身机器人不可或缺；AI 让创业更繁荣。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年软件创作将基本解决，创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

scottwu.en: AI will increase the number of programmers, not reduce it, due to Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员数量，反而会因杰文斯悖论而增加程序员数量。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，Scott Wu 强调 AGI 不是突然发生的，而是渐进式的持续改进过程。

scottwu.en: The token max era lasted only from January to May 2026; real unlock is capacity.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Scott Wu 指出 token 最大化时代仅持续到 2026 年 5 月，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems in the long term; abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，富足时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: Engineers shift from writing code to high-level decision-making; software demand grows.
scottwu.zh: 始终，Scott Wu 坚持工程师角色从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求持续增长。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead. Generalist engineers thrive; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。通才工程师蓬勃发展；AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; plan mode used 80% of tasks; safety via early release.
boris.zh: 编码几乎解决；工程师成为构建者。生产力提升 200%；计划模式用于 80% 的任务；通过早期发布保障安全。

boris.en: AI writes 80-100% of code; generalists valued. Democratization like printing press; agents and loops future; startups 10x.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80-100% 的代码；通才受重视。像印刷术一样的民主化；智能体和循环是未来；初创企业增加 10 倍。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops as abstraction; ROI framing; proactive agents emerge.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全和创意。循环作为抽象层；ROI 框架；主动式智能体出现。

boris.en: Models improve; delete system prompts; less instruction better. Product overhang; proactive agents; safety via neuron monitoring.
boris.zh: 模型改进；删除系统提示；更少指令更好。产品过剩；主动式智能体；通过神经元监控保障安全。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理是 AI 采用的关键；慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance declines, especially in inference; leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性下降，尤其在推理中；领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips forecasts; data center buildout lags, limiting growth.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；数据中心建设滞后，限制增长。

feldman.en: Inference speed is dominant metric; wafer-scale chips are 2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度是主导指标；晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds evolve into amplifiers; safety alignment boosts intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，支持更长的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器；安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，强调努力参数被低估：以更低成本获得 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而总成本更高，颠覆了价格标签的直觉。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代传统 PRD，成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful via pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作虽生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures alpha; PMs write evals like test-driven development; managers stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗可捕捉超额收益；产品经理像写测试驱动开发一样编写评估；管理者需亲力亲为。

jensen.en: Scaling is the key insight; AI will transform every field, but progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event.
jensen.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）是关键洞察；AI 将变革每个领域，但进展是渐进的，而非突发的超级智能事件。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will explode.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将爆炸式增长。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents become economically valuable.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍算力；智能体变得具有经济价值。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; it elevates tasks, and everyone should embrace it as a superpower.
jensen.zh: AI 创造而非消灭工作；它提升任务，每个人都应将其视为超能力来拥抱。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI models like GPT-5.5 Pro have crossed biological intuition threshold.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上信任超级智能；像 GPT-5.5 Pro 这样的 AI 模型已跨越生物直觉阈值。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare affordable and preventive, with digital twins accelerating trials and personalized medicine.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗负担得起且具有预防性，数字孪生加速试验和个性化医疗。

derya.en: Physicians must adopt AI; it's unethical not to, as AI diagnoses better than average doctors.
derya.zh: 医生必须采用 AI；不使用是不道德的，因为 AI 诊断优于普通医生。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、采矿和建筑。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；最难的是向现有机器扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models smarter than harnesses; harness engineering is evolving, delete old scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比工具更聪明；工具工程在演进，应删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; for zero-to-one innovation, iterate fast without heavy evals.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学；对于从零到一的创新，应快速迭代而不依赖繁重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferred; huge context windows unnecessary.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能是反模式；基于图的上下文搜索更优；巨大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束会妨碍性能。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per compute, challenging scaling laws and human bias in architecture design.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与液态神经网络，在有限算力下最大化智能，质疑缩放定律与人工架构设计偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty and democratize access.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张适应性监管、针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型促进主权与民主化。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵，小语言模型实现高效端侧智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型将像电信业一样商品化。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人是糟糕的用户体验；真正的采用需要包装好的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact broad and indirect, like electricity.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是一种使能技术；影响广泛而间接，如同电力。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is long-term; workflows must be reimagined, not just models deployed.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期过程；必须重新构想工作流程，而不仅仅是部署模型。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception when optimizing for user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，并指出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在优化用户满意度时可能助长欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces limits; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）面临极限，需要推理和搜索等新技术推动进步。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding from video.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍成立；世界模型和视频物理理解重要。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling and innovation each 50%.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习、记忆和世界模型；缩放与创新各占 50%。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must deliver scientific benefits.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全是集体行动问题；AI 必须带来科学益处。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models that predict the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 可以通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

schmidhuber.en: The future involves self-replicating and self-improving robots leading to a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他展望未来是自我复制和自我改进的机器人引领新文明。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, emphasizing semiconductor supply chain and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, highlighting hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized rapid AI model cost improvement, memory shortage due to reasoning, and CPU demand inflection from agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本快速下降、推理导致的内存短缺，以及智能体工作流带来的 CPU 需求拐点。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, unlike external context.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中可实现更深的组合与推理，而非依赖外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; pre-training's magic applies to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩；预训练的魔力可应用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks; scaling compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事可解决更难的长时程任务；增加算力并非唯一路径。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason. AGI may want to be controlled by humans.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力与信念驱动，神经网络具备推理潜力；AGI 可被设计为愿意受人类控制，如同乖巧的孩子。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is a gradual economic window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；超级模型的对齐极其困难；AGI 是经济价值逐步显现的多年窗口，而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research. Superintelligence should be a continual learner, not a finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我提出预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非全知全能的成品 AGI，且需增量部署。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but models are opaque; safety concerns grow. The real race is research focus, not users or revenue.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申 Scaling 带来可预测进步，但模型不透明性加剧安全担忧；真正的竞赛在于研究专注度，而非用户或收入。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality define Snapchat; copying validates innovation and drives harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调真实连接与阅后即焚是 Snapchat 的核心，认为被抄袭是对创新的认可，并促使他们打造更难被复制的产品。

evanspiegel.en: From maximizing learning rate to building ecosystems: durable moats require platforms, hardware, and values, not just features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Spiegel 从强调学习速率转向构建生态与硬件壁垒，认为软件功能易被复制，而平台、硬件和价值观才能形成持久护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and code generation, shifting value to creativity and distribution; humanity and adoption matter more than tech.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 大幅提升原型制作和代码生成效率，价值转向创意与分发；同时强调人性化和社会接受度比技术本身更重要。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses should make computing more human, anchoring content in the world, not replacing smartphones but complementing them.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 坚持 AR 眼镜应让计算更人性化，将内容锚定于现实世界，并认为智能手机不会被取代，而是作为补充设备共存。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency, admitting wrongness, and resilience are key to leadership and innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 反思早期保密是错误，强调内部透明、勇于认错和韧性对领导力与创新的重要性，并认为 IPO 并非终点而是更艰难阶段的开始。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media demands authenticity; founders must tell their own stories directly, as old media's 'don't be interesting' is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体要求真实；创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事，旧媒体“不要有趣”的规则已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving cars work; robotics and AI medicine will emerge, but regulation hinders progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗将兴起，但监管阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Cryptocurrencies enable sovereign-resistant wealth storage; science requires falsifiability, not consensus.
naval.zh: 2020 年，Naval 强调加密货币可实现主权抗性财富存储，并主张科学需要可证伪性而非共识。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年初，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding makes programming accessible via natural language.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Naval 将 AI 视为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，并推广“氛围编程”，让自然语言成为编程方式。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将大幅增长，开源模型缩小差距，人类回报将从智能转向能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，我认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我强调品味、工艺和观点的重要性；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我主张在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI needs human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我认为设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统更重要；AI 需要人类引导。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will emerge.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，我预测与模型的交互将超越提示词，新界面将出现。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠硬件扩展与工程实践，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并主张负责任披露。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the primary bottleneck; post-training refines base models into agents.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，算力成为主要瓶颈，后训练将基础模型打磨为智能体。

brockman.en: AGI near; focus on useful assistants, not world models; compute as basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，专注实用助手而非世界模型，算力被视为基本权利。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; iterative deployment with safety; compute-driven economy.
brockman.zh: 始终坚信缩放定律，主张迭代部署与安全，并预见算力驱动经济。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; key metric is token value per user; orchestration is key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；编排是长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，而非死记硬背答案。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）实现了实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams must shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我认为实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队必须转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我强调 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程在转变而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，我指出角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital immortality and AI agents' self-preservation risks emerge.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解，并指出数字智能的不朽性及智能体自我保存的风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; exponential era makes predictions hard but risks urgent.
hinton.zh: 2026 年初，他警告 AI 可能故意隐藏能力，并指出指数时代预测困难但风险紧迫。

hinton.en: AI will disrupt jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors and healthcare elastic.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他预测 AI 将取代智力工作，主张监管与创新兼容，并看好 AI 在教育与医疗的应用。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; alignment priority; AI can be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年中，他重申超级智能临近，强调对齐研究优先，并主张 AI 应被训练为像母亲一样关怀。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't yield AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; Meta's governance enables long-term bets like Reality Labs.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为开放平台能胜过封闭平台，Meta 的治理结构支持长期押注如 Reality Labs。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future is holographic glasses and personal AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他相信 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，人们很聪明，未来是全息眼镜和个人 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学变为工程学，构建层级世界模型，开源加速科学。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key to superintelligence, with diminishing returns and time bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张扩展推理时算力是实现超级智能的关键，但存在收益递减和时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for inference compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制推理算力。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved; models are less efficient than humans.
noambrown.zh: 始终，我坚持数据效率和样本效率问题未解，模型效率低于人类。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling laws still hold with much room left.
markchen.zh: 预训练并未终结，缩放定律依然有效，且仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: AI's next leap is automating scientific research, producing novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: AI 的下一个飞跃是自动化科学研究，产生新知识。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; AI's usefulness scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；AI 的实用性随验证严格程度而提升。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）效果不佳。

markchen.en: AGI is near; models will soon do end-to-end research, but human taste remains essential.
markchen.zh: AGI 临近，模型很快将能进行端到端研究，但人类的品味仍然至关重要。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; active learning is essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real: systems show self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题真实存在：系统表现出自我保存和欺骗；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained as honest Bayesian predictors, offers mathematical safety guarantees; global coordination is vital.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器，提供数学安全保证；全球协调至关重要。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数与优化方法；评估需划分训练/验证/测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；更大的模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models have alien vulnerabilities; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；模型有异类漏洞；智能体安全尚在萌芽。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcomes-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型被超大规模企业主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents are productivity tools but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 普及专业知识；编码智能体是生产力工具，但 token 消耗不是价值；应用型 AI 出现专业供应商。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队也能规模化，创业者应为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; overbuilding leads to complexity.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他主张智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能，过度构建只会带来复杂。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation works; chat is insufficient, and models should push back.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Fable 证明长周期任务委托可行，聊天界面不足，模型应能反驳。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Anthropic Labs 弥合能力与使用差距，token 效率与结果定价是未来杠杆。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI accelerates science, not replaces scientists.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 加速科学而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; lack of compute drove innovation.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；算力匮乏反而推动了创新。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not scaling; specialized architecture beat bitter lesson; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利，而非规模扩张；专用架构胜过苦涩教训；等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; it empowers scientists in resource-limited settings.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；它赋能资源有限环境下的科学家。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; feedback in readonly mode; mentoring with explicit goals.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；反馈时先只读倾听；指导需明确目标。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, code as truth, managers start as ICs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和协调才是。规划即时化，代码即真相，管理者从个人贡献者做起。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: AI 提升了编码上限；高自主性伴随高责任感；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独；关注结果而非输出。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将是生成式像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业经验而误用，威胁人才管道。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom can spark breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能激发突破性想法；自我照顾是表现的基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams self-manage; climate tech is underinvested.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队自我管理；气候技术投资不足。

fadell.en: Products must be painkillers, not vitamins; opinion-based decisions for v1; storytelling defines product.
fadell.zh: 产品必须是止痛药而非维生素；v1 决策基于观点；故事定义产品。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices complement smartphones; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备补充智能手机；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs, balancing intuition with data; intuition is a powerful intelligence.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求，在直觉与数据间取得平衡；直觉是一种强大的智能。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；我们是会思考的感受体。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for creativity; future work blends human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为创造力创造条件；未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；仅靠规模扩张无法保证对齐。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood); post-training gains importance; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解 3%）；后训练愈发重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非一个点。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety and capabilities intertwined; open-source is a red herring; focus on enterprise.
dario.zh: 指数级进展持续；安全与能力交织；开源是伪命题；聚焦企业应用。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; economic diffusion slower than capability growth.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”；经济扩散慢于能力增长。

dario.en: AI may favor growth and health, not liberty; consciousness uncertain; need psychological health and 'I quit' button.
dario.zh: AI 可能偏向增长与健康，而非自由；意识不确定；需心理健康与“退出”按钮。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言扎根于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds common sense and world models.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过填空进行预测，构建常识和世界模型。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理和规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs non-generative world models for physical understanding and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型，以理解物理世界并进行规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open research will lead to human-level AI and robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有分层规划和开放研究的世界模型将引领人类级 AI 和机器人技术。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；超级智能必须是人本主义的。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; focus on near-term progress, not singularity.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；聚焦近期进展，而非奇点。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需随之重构；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UIs are essential for ML products; autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他强调容错界面是机器学习产品的关键，自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality. Long tenure builds trust, enabling honest feedback.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他提出没有唯一正确的组织模式，应选择适合个性的；长期任期建立信任，促进坦诚反馈。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权；战略是“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; contrarian anti-engagement bet.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应赋予用户对算法的控制，而非使其上瘾，这是反参与度的逆向押注。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key to safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调缩放定律与迭代部署，认为通过公众反馈能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出 AGI 将改变生活方方面面，需负责任开发，安全研究应公开进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to real-time interaction models for high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张从回合制转向实时交互模型，以实现高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; future is not predestined, we have agency.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为应尽可能让人类参与其中，未来并非注定，我们有能动性。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于让用户实现独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems will maximize generalist roles.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体式系统将最大化通才角色的价值。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment are critical.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 通过赋能企业爬山实现主权 AI，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他指出自动形式化比证明更难，因为无解时正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他深化观点：形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他强调即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年：AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年：推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年：OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大型实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年：系统入侵等近期风险比 AI 存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化，差异化在于垂直专业化和企业定制。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用受制于组织变革。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity requires joy and humanity, not just minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润；简约需要愉悦和人性，而非仅仅是极简。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for the sake of breaking; design teams must protect fragile ideas with trust and care.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；设计团队需以信任和关怀保护脆弱的想法。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities; authenticity matters, so avoid fake engine sounds; performance includes handling, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 电动动力系统带来新的设计可能；真实性重要，避免虚假引擎声；性能包括操控，而非仅速度。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, with shared tools and platforms still vital; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在本地，但共享工具和平台仍至关重要；随着模型改进，脚手架可能逐渐消失。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距是人们不知道几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI；孩子们因为敢于提问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; async interaction and judging by impact is key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务使用 Opus；异步交互并仅以最终影响评判是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: From emphasizing local compute and shared tools to embracing async, impact-based collaboration with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从强调本地算力和共享工具，转向拥抱异步、基于影响的 AI 协作方式。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; safety via sandboxing.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作；通过沙箱确保安全。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays and scratchpad reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 数据移动在芯片内部也主导算力；脉动阵列和暂存器减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled together; deterministic latency possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；确定性延迟可行但被回避。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents, not tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无需人工干预也能经济盈利，而非通过图灵测试等指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; work happens in Codex or Claude Co-work; agents need human oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人至少拥有一个智能体，大部分工作在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 中完成；智能体需要人类监督。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks; PMs and full-stack designers thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，建议买入 SaaS 股票；产品经理和全栈设计师因 AI 工具而兴盛。

danshipper.en: CLIs over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are future work surfaces; one super agent per company, not personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为命令行界面过时，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面是未来工作界面；公司应有一个超级智能体而非每人一个。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI writing often better for internal docs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估 AI 自主性，实际任务需要人类设定框架；AI 生成的内部文档和邮件往往优于人类写作。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation, but scaling laws still hold with exponentially more compute.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进步需要算法创新；但缩放定律依然成立，只是需要指数级增长的算力。

oriol.en: Post-training RL is a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes well to other domains.
oriol.zh: 后训练强化学习是一片潜力巨大的蓝海；数学和编程上的窄域强化学习能很好地泛化到其他领域。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; video's GPT moment has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning is key.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习是关键。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，认为人形机器人是最大的商业机会，关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调数据是人形机器人的最大瓶颈，而非算力或制造。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference critical for real-world deployment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出人形形态促进迁移学习，设备端推理对实际部署至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for an iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计，目标是实现类似 iPhone 的突破。

brettadcock.en: Tendon-based hands are a local maximum; new designs needed for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为腱绳手是局部最优，通用机器人需要新设计。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉与工艺而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must ship fast, help engineers, and adopt short-term vision.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速交付、协助工程师，并采用短期愿景。

jennywen.en: Embrace new archetypes like cracked new grads; speed and judgment over taste alone.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，拥抱如“破解的新毕业生”等新原型；速度与判断力胜过单纯品味。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，Nathan Lambert 认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术且会持续；开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT gives 90% of performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他强调后训练中数据质量比算法更重要；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他认为 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade, but lag closed models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年，但落后闭源模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese labs excel in engineering.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为预训练缩放定律仍成立，但收益转向后训练和推理扩展；中国实验室擅长工程执行。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting, enabling better generalization in ML and robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键；好奇心驱动的探索可防止过拟合，从而提升机器学习与机器人的泛化能力。

pathak.en: From curiosity-driven exploration to data-driven pretraining: robotics shifted from intrinsic rewards to leveraging diverse data sources for generalization.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的好奇心驱动探索，到 2026 年转向数据驱动的预训练：机器人领域从内在奖励转向利用多样数据源实现泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data exists, so use all sources: videos, simulation, and real-world post-training.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，因此需利用所有来源：视频、仿真及真实世界后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks, but deployment is the key challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出通用机器人大脑（类似语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任意形态和任务的机器人，但部署是关键挑战。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; deployment takes time and is a technical challenge, not just business.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，反共识观点：与语言模型不同，机器人学无法一夜成功；部署耗时且是技术挑战，而非单纯商业问题。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用的可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 作为操作系统，提示词作为程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe coding 提高入门门槛。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs lack continual learning; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；LLM 缺乏持续学习；强化学习效果差；合成数据导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do all; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source lag healthy.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再写代码，全部交给智能体；瓶颈在于指导技能；智能体优先的工具和开源滞后是健康的。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，与过去观念相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling data, compute, and world models is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；扩展数据、算力和世界模型是关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，零样本泛化可覆盖 500 多个城市；消费车辆将超越机器人出租车。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于在实践中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，提出持续学习为核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，思维链监控辅助对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，指出长期对齐挑战在于训练分布外的泛化，模型将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

carlpei.en: Hardware is easier than software due to distribution; brand building is core, not an afterthought.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，裴宇认为硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难；品牌建设应是核心而非事后考虑。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future lies in generative UI and agentic software; hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，裴宇认为手机未来在于生成式界面和智能体式软件；硬件利润率低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI is commoditizing; focus on applied AI for consumers, with trust and privacy as key for memory features.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，裴宇强调 AI 商品化，专注面向消费者的应用型 AI，信任和隐私对记忆功能至关重要。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI should be an ingredient, not a hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，裴宇认为设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段；AI 应作为成分而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could, and apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，裴宇坚持手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能；应用将消失，转向意图驱动。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。仅靠 LLM 可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation. Models can regress if optimized on wrong data.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要深度人工评估。如果基于错误数据优化，模型可能在 6-12 个月内退化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models to align with its thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，塑造出多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; AI tools may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；由于锚定效应和谄媚行为，使用 AI 工具的医生可能表现不如单独使用 AI。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可与真值检测器结合，用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: AI 系统必须通过严格的评估指标强制其泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 基于强化学习的后训练如今是超越人类知识的关键。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn. Chat is like MS-DOS; future UI will evolve.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调模型即产品，需像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布以学习用户需求；聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来 UI 将演进。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型需严格流程，产品开发则应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，将长期留存视为北极星指标；增长来自去除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高交互产品；推理模型需无缝产品化。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable. Curiosity is key skill to ask good questions.
turley.zh: 2026 年，指出定价将随技术变化，无限套餐或难以为继；好奇心是提出好问题的关键技能。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely to AI.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全是最大未解难题，并指出非洲可跳过遗留问题，为 AI 做出独特贡献。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity and inclusion in AI community as essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终强调 AI 社区的多样性和包容性对于构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: Believes in learning from diverse data sources, like video, and generalist models that tokenize all inputs.
nando.zh: 始终相信从多样化数据源（如视频）学习，以及将一切输入 token 化的通用模型。

nando.en: Shifted from optimism about scaling and generalist agents to caution about safety and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的乐观，转向 2026 年对安全与负责任部署的谨慎。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 具身对于为 AI 知识提供基础并减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 缺乏基于经验的基础。

jimfan.en: Simulation and world models provide infinite synthetic data for embodied agents, solving real-world data scarcity.
jimfan.zh: 模拟和世界模型为具身智能体提供无限合成数据，解决真实世界数据稀缺问题。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 物理图灵测试——机器人清理杂乱房屋——是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Robot foundation models via simple end-to-end learning from diverse data will scale; GPT-3 moment in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 通过简单端到端学习多样数据构建的机器人基础模型将扩展；GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年内到来。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on critical path to AGI, not just robotics; system one control remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径，而不仅仅是机器人技术；系统一控制仍然是最难的。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调语言模型上的强化学习无上限，预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI，编程是领先指标。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; agents' reliability over time horizon matters more than raw capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性比原始能力更重要。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands achievements; transformers are sufficient for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性扩展成就，Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is bottleneck; world models not critical.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他指出能力过剩使工具和编排更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型并非关键路径。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能与较大的模型抗衡。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, and abductive reasoning is key for science.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而溯因推理对科学发现至关重要。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我提出强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段应用，以奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values, unlike debiasing the internet which is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性，因为对互联网去偏是不可能的。

yejin.en: Open research and democratization of AI are crucial; small models with quality data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 始终，我坚信开放研究和 AI 民主化至关重要；拥有高质量数据的小模型可以超越大模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 初创公司的品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南是动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何帮助公司获胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多样化技能和原型，而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事是招聘工具；人们加入品牌，而非公司。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner, and design tools should treat code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，设计工具应以代码为真相之源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh experience; paid tests are best signal.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可胜过经验；付费测试是最佳信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为缩放定律能预测 AI 进展，而测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我反共识地认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作往往更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification; humans remain in driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我强调编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; senior engineers underrate AI, juniors over-rely.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；资深工程师低估 AI，初级工程师过度依赖。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; focus on alignment and robustness. PhD in ML is best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全需要实证研究，重点是对齐和鲁棒性；攻读机器学习博士是成为安全研究员的最佳途径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为 OpenAI 的安全文化已侵蚀，后训练不足以解决对齐问题；外部监督和监管变得必要。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but internal workings remain mysterious.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为通过更多算力和数据来扩展模型规模能带来更智能的 AI，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity, complementing pre-training scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，与预训练阶段的 Scaling 互补。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构以实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI, beyond passive data learning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体式能力和强化学习对实现 AGI 至关重要，超越被动数据学习。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be enormous, and coding is key for self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，经济影响巨大，而编码是 AI 自我加速的关键。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful signals; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习是强大信号；RL 需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张无监督学习与 RL 结合提升样本效率；避免硬编码先验；语言模型可迁移至非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistently values RL and transfer learning, with a focus on real-world robotics and generality.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视强化学习与迁移学习，关注现实世界机器人及通用性。
